product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines data from autonomous long-duration weather balloons with AI forecasting models to provide atmospheric observations and forecasts for governments, businesses, researchers, and other weather-sensitive organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The readable homepage navigation and footer do not expose a pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The index includes multiple technical posts, including WeatherMesh technical blogs and Engineering Notebook posts.

public_docs.notes: The public API documentation contains multiple sections and articles for authentication, SDKs, data formats, forecasts, observations, events, models, and webhooks.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role list is readable and includes engineering, manufacturing, launch, and sensor-data roles, but no qualifying AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.notes: WindBorne describes WeatherMesh as its proprietary AI model. It publicly mentions building with OpenAI and Codex, but does not identify an external model provider for the WeatherMesh product itself.

compliance_certs.notes: The readable legal/privacy page does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced in August 2026, within the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable current-opening list contains no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: WindBorne announced Weather Events on 2026-10-29, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small leadership list shows the current leadership; the dated profile evidence places the COO's start in August 2025, outside the 12-month window ending 2026-11-09, and no qualifying departure is announced there.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job board and public API documentation do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
